## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmation 1: sector breadth is weak (2/11), Confirmation 2: large-cap Tech and Consumer leaders (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, META, TSLA) are collectively BELOW TREND, signaling broad risk aversion; leadership concentrated in Energy/Financials rather than defensive stocks.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +4.13% | 1M: +13.74%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +4.02% | 1M: +20.39%) ABOVE TREND. Financials showing tactical strength: WFC (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -11.39%) RECOVERY, MS (1W: +4.26% | 1M: -7.40%) RECOVERY, GS (1W: +4.00% | 1M: -10.78%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors represented in Top 5).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Utilities weakest: CEG (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -3.19%) BELOW TREND, EXC (1W: -6.78% | 1M: -1.10%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -8.01% | 1M: -15.24%) BELOW TREND. Materials/Industrials following: FCX (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -16.75%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -12.58% | 1M: -23.45%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -16.51%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: LRCX (1W: +7.62% | 1M: -3.69%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND, WFC (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -11.39%) RECOVERY, AMAT (1W: +4.55% | 1M: -3.45%) RECOVERY, SLB (1W: +4.27% | 1M: -9.53%) RECOVERY — leadership concentrated in Energy/Financials/Tech.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: CEG (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -3.19%) BELOW TREND, ABBV (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -8.59%) BELOW TREND, SBUX (1W: -6.66% | 1M: -3.39%) BELOW TREND, EXC (1W: -6.78% | 1M: -1.10%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -16.51%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Utilities/Healthcare/Industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W movers: LRCX (1W: +7.62% | 1M: -3.69%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND, WFC (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -11.39%) RECOVERY, AMAT (1W: +4.55% | 1M: -3.45%) RECOVERY, SLB (1W: +4.27% | 1M: -9.53%) RECOVERY — note MAJOR divergence across banks and select Tech (≥3 major names showing 1W ≠ 1M), so treat as tactical, not structural.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Tech mixed to weak: NVDA (1W: -4.19% | 1M: -8.08%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -4.83%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.46% | 1M: -4.16%) BELOW TREND, but LRCX (1W: +7.62% | 1M: -3.69%) RECOVERY and AMAT (1W: +4.55% | 1M: -3.45%) RECOVERY show tactical bounces; sector 1W: -0.76% | 1M: -2.27% (24 stocks).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials showing tactical recovery in banks: WFC (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -11.39%) RECOVERY, MS (1W: +4.26% | 1M: -7.40%) RECOVERY, GS (1W: +4.00% | 1M: -10.78%) RECOVERY while card processors V (1W: -1.80% | 1M: -5.43%) BELOW TREND and MA (1W: -0.34% | 1M: -4.60%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W: +0.84% | 1M: -7.37% (20 stocks).

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare weak overall: LLY (1W: -7.96% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND, ABBV (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -8.59%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -2.55% | 1M: -4.17%) BELOW TREND, but PFE (1W: +1.47% | 1M: +0.41%) ABOVE TREND is an outlier; sector 1W: -2.47% | 1M: -7.07% (17 stocks).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor Energy and select Financials on tactical strength (OXY, COP, XOM, WFC, MS) and reduce exposure to large-cap Tech and high-multiple Consumer/Industrials (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, BA) given RISK-OFF backdrop; Style: Value/Cyclical favored but with caution due to narrow leadership and news divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND — follow-through needed; COP (1W: +4.13% | 1M: +13.74%) ABOVE TREND; PFE (1W: +1.47% | 1M: +0.41%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: BA (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -16.51%) BELOW TREND; CEG (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -3.19%) BELOW TREND; ACN (1W: -? | 1M: -?) BELOW TREND — monitor news-driven downside (ACN sentiment -60).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.90% | 1M: +10.31%) — momentum and breadth within sector are supportive.  
BEARISH: Utilities (1W: -5.55% | 1M: -3.80%), Materials (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -10.87%) — watch for continued selling and earnings/news flow.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA: need sustained 1W improvement (turn 1M loss toward flat) to challenge prior range; AAPL: a 1W > +2% follow-through would be early sign of stabilization from BELOW TREND; XOM/CVX: hold 1M gains (keep ABOVE TREND) to confirm sector leadership; WFC/MS: continued weekly follow-through (>+2% 1W) would confirm RECOVERY across banks.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**

ACN (-60): price-target cuts on AI narrative; ACN (1W: ? | 1M: ?) likely to show further weakness given negative sentiment and Tech/IT rotation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF with a Value/Cyclical tilt as Energy and select Financials lead; Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. XOM (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +5.76%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND, WFC (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -11.39%) RECOVERY are showing relative strength. Key risk: major-cap Tech and select names (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA) remain BELOW TREND and several bullish headlines (LLY, NVDA) are not confirming in price — monitor for distribution and trend breaks.
